module.Title: Build the First Foundry Dashboard
module.Teaching: A useful program combines several types and output statements. This dashboard stores the system identity and live values, then sends them to the terminal in a readable sequence.
module.PredictionQuestion: Which declaration stores the yes-or-no operating state?
module.PredictionExplanation: engineOnline uses bool because it represents true or false.
module.DebugPrompt: Repair the std namespaces, quotation marks, assignment operators, Boolean value, output operators, newline text, and semicolons.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the exact Forge Core dashboard. Create std::string systemName with Forge Core, int engineTemperature with 72, int engineOutput with 85, and bool engineOnline with true. Use the exact identifiers std and cout as std::cout to print systemName, engineTemperature, engineOutput, and engineOnline, with the exact newline text \n after every value.
module.TransferPrompt: Create the exact maintenance dashboard. Create std::string dashboardName with Maintenance, int openJobs with 3, and bool maintenanceMode with true. Use the exact identifiers std and cout as std::cout to print dashboardName, openJobs, and maintenanceMode, with the exact newline text \n after every value.
module.PreviewMessage: Chapter 1 complete: the first Engine Foundry dashboard is operational.
